page: City page: B2B lead generation London (/b2b-lead-generation-london)

items.question: Does Myntmore have an office in London?
items.answer: No. Myntmore's only office is in BKC, Mumbai, and every engagement runs remotely. Companies selling to London work with us over calls, a shared dashboard and a weekly report, the same way our other clients do. This page describes the London market we reach, not a local branch.

items.question: Who is lead generation for London built for?
items.answer: B2B companies that want meetings with London buyers, mainly financial services, fintech, professional services and SaaS firms. That includes firms based there and Indian or international companies selling into United Kingdom. If your buyers are businesses, not consumers, the same system adapts to your ICP.

items.question: We are an Indian company that wants clients in London. Can you help?
items.answer: Yes. We build separate sending domains so your main domain is never at risk, write copy for buyers in London and send in their working hours. London is 4.5 hours behind India in summer and 5.5 hours in winter, so meetings fit the Indian afternoon. Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff.

items.question: Is cold email allowed for London buyers?
items.answer: UK GDPR allows B2B cold email on a legitimate interest basis when the message is relevant to the recipient's role. Under PECR, emails to corporate addresses don't need prior consent but must identify the sender and offer an opt-out. This is general information, not legal advice.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.
